reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Kevin was one of the best trades I had during my renovation. Very good communication, honest, helpful and dependable. He did an excellent job removing the creaks from my victorian staircase and helped trouble shot and fix some odd jobs. Clearly a very talented carpenter who I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and use again!
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Kevin did a superb job working on our front door, adding peephole and fixing a faulty lock. … He is very attentive to detail and is very good with wood indeed! Kind, punctual and also very helpful advising what tools or hardware will be needed to achieve your vision.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Good With Wood is carpentry of excellence. Kevin runs this business, and is a craftsman of distinction. … Basically, you will get the very highest quality work from Good With Wood at a fair price.
items.label: Which? review
